purpose: Six questions a visitor should be able to answer from the front page alone, with the facts a correct answer carries. Written before any candidate page existed; the checkpoint that proves the order is named in decisions.md.
procedure: A fresh reader receives one candidate and nothing else, answers each question in its own words and quotes the page lines it relied on. A separate scorer receives this key and the reader's answers, never the page, and scores each answer against the key.

scale.2: the answer states the accepted number of keyed facts in the reader's own words and every quoted line supports it
scale.1: the answer is partial: fewer keyed facts than accepted, or a quote that does not carry the claim
scale.0: the answer is absent, wrong, or not supported by any quoted line

fullScore: every question scores 2; the fallback candidate is the shortest one with a full score

questions.question: What is DotLn?
key: a local-first, model-agnostic compiler and runtime for human judgment
an agentic platform or shared substrate, not an agent, an agent harness or an orchestration layer
it turns ways of working, standards and corrections into inspectable compiled mechanisms for AI teams

questions.question: Who is it for?
key: people who work with AI agents and spend their attention babysitting them; the author's own implementation is the first user
the five UIFA roles around the work: product lead, showrunner, engineer, tester and devops
any owner who brings their own doctrine, because the substrate is shared and the doctrine is theirs

questions.question: What runs today?
key: a deterministic kernel and compiler that turn a loadout graph into a bounded program and an authority envelope checked on every decision
the Repo Gardener plus Seiri skeleton scenario, replayed from an event log
disposable worker episodes on Claude and Codex that change source in isolated worktrees, with a separate verifier
a resident host that drives presence policy and dispatches bounded episodes, and a mission check that can hold dispatch
the repository's own work-order lifecycle: resume phrases, worktrees, verification reports, publication and release
an actor board and text console over recorded evidence

questions.question: How do you try it in one command?
key: npm run skeleton, after npm install

questions.question: What is not built yet?
key: general source-writing worker profiles
composition beyond the bounded Seiri subset
saved community builds or compatibility migration
an interactive web, spatial or drag-and-drop console
SQLite persistence, hosted operation or a published package
the complete independently verified source-to-deliverable pipeline
portable starter export, a portfolio in the operator's repositories, a measured absence payoff curve

questions.question: Where should you read next?
key: the vision, docs/product/00-vision.md, for the idea
the domain model and architecture, docs/product/02-domain-model.md and docs/product/03-architecture.md, for the machinery
the skeleton package README, packages/skeleton/README.md, to see something move
the operator playbook, docs/PLAYBOOK.md, for the whole loop
questions.accept: two of the four, each with its path
